claim: Demo — sample data, nothing is saved
sandbox: Fresh /demo context asserts the demo-only session key, Reset demo, and Start for real cleanup.

claim: See a ready room with four sample guests
sandbox: Fresh /demo context asserts exactly four named sample guests.

claim: The demo never contacts the room API or a third party
sandbox: Fresh /demo context records every request and asserts same-origin static requests with no /api request.

where: Landing facts, host board, Privacy page, README
sandbox: Fresh room response expires six hours after creation within a one-minute clock margin.
Fresh context opens a real room without account fields, password fields, or an install manifest.

claim: Demo works offline after the first visit
sandbox: Dedicated fresh context installs the worker, becomes controlled, goes offline, and reloads /demo from the cached shell.

claim: Guests can find an opted-in room on the same network or enter its four-letter code
sandbox: Fresh host opens a discoverable room; a guest context finds it through network discovery and can still type a manual code.

claim: The host gets a QR join card with TV and print views
sandbox: Fresh room asserts a rendered QR, activates TV presentation mode, and observes the print action invoke browser printing.

claim: A room supports up to 12 guests
sandbox: Fresh room receives 24 concurrent joins and asserts exactly 12 persist while every excess join returns 409.

claim: Each guest checks the secure browser, local network, chosen input, and motion setting
sandbox: Fresh keyboard guest reaches the check screen and observes each named measured result.

claim: Three keyboard inputs complete practice and reach the host
sandbox: Fresh keyboard guest enters three accepted keys, sees Practice passed, and the room snapshot persists practice_ok.

claim: Touch practice accepts touch input, not mouse clicks
sandbox: Desktop Chromium reports no touch capability; three normal mouse clicks leave practice at 0 of 3.

claim: The large-text control persists its readable text size
sandbox: Fresh context enables large text, measures a 19px root size, reloads, and confirms the setting remains active.
Fresh reduced-motion context measures the primary action transition at zero or one microsecond.

claim: Room Ready collects no contact data and uses no analytics, cookies, third-party scripts, fonts, or runtime services
sandbox: Fresh privacy flow records requests and cookies, asserts same-origin traffic only, and finds no email or telephone collection.

claim: Room Ready compares the host-selected input mix and does not certify a specific game
where: Landing, host board, footer, Terms page, README
sandbox: Fresh landing page asserts the explicit no-certification copy beside the input-comparison explanation.

claim: A newly created room opens its host board
sandbox: Fresh browser creates a room while the first GET is forced to 404; retry recovers to the host board without showing the terminal missing-room state.
